dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a near-linear to very slightly concave spline from the apex to the posterior base insertion.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Broadly rounded apex with an obtuse shape classification and a large pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Shallow angular steepness of approximately 25 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Highly elongated base width to vertical height ratio of approximately 2.5:1.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Low-profile convexity with a large arc radius, presenting a flattened anterior-dorsal cranial boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short and robust rostrum with a thick pixel profile relative to its minimal forward extension.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Subtle inflection point characterized by a wide interior angle of approximately 165 degrees where the melon meets the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent, high-aspect ratio caudal flukes with acute, wing-like tips and a deep median notch.
